## Overview This PR adds complete Ledger hardware wallet support for TRON, including wallet metadata, provider integration, and comprehensive documentation in both English and Chinese. ## Changes ### Core Implementation - **Added `LedgerWallet` metadata** (`packages/tron/src/wallets/ledgerWallet.tsx`) - Configured as "Popular" group wallet - Includes proper naming and hardware wallet description - **Integrated Ledger adapter** into TRON provider (`packages/tron/src/provider/index.tsx`) - Imported `LedgerAdapter` from `@tronweb3/tronwallet-adapter-ledger` - Added to adapters array in `TronWeb3ConfigProvider` - **Added dependency**: `@tronweb3/tronwallet-adapter-ledger@^1.1.11` ### Documentation Created standalone Ledger documentation section parallel to TRON: **New Ledger Section (`packages/web3/src/ledger/`):** - Created as a separate top-level section (order: 9, after TRON) - English documentation (`index.md`) with installation, demo, prerequisites, and features - Chinese documentation (`index.zh-CN.md`) with complete translations - Dedicated demo showing TRON + Ledger integration (`demos/tron.tsx`) **TRON Section Updates:** - Added "Ledger" to supported wallets list in both `index.md` and `index.zh-CN.md` ### Demo Created a concise demo (`packages/web3/src/ledger/demos/tron.tsx`) showing Ledger usage with TRON: ```tsx import { ConnectButton, Connector } from '@ant-design/web3'; import { LedgerWallet, TronWeb3ConfigProvider } from '@ant-design/web3-tron'; const App: React.FC = () => { return ( ); }; ``` ## Key Features - 🔐 **Hardware-level security**: Private keys never leave the Ledger device - ✅ **Physical confirmation**: All TRON transactions require device confirmation - 📱 **Simple integration**: Works seamlessly with existing TRON infrastructure - 📚 **Complete documentation**: Both English and Chinese with clear prerequisites - 📂 **Proper structure**: Ledger documentation is a standalone section parallel to other blockchain sections ## Prerequisites Documented - Chrome/Edge browser (WebHID support required) - Ledger device connected via USB - Device unlocked with TRON app open ## Testing - ✅ All builds pass successfully - ✅ All TRON package tests pass (10/10) - ✅ No lint errors introduced - ✅ Code formatted with Biome ## Changeset Added changeset for proper version management: - `@ant-design/web3-tron`: minor (new feature) - `@ant-design/web3`: patch (documentation) > [!WARNING] > > Created from VS Code via the GitHub Pull Request extension.
